---
applyTo: "**/+page.svelte
---

Import precompiled types from @prisma/client, like Prisma.<ModelName>UncheckedCreateInput, Prisma.<ModelName>UncheckedUpdateInput, etc. to use them in the front-end, when needed to add data to the database.
Every front-end page starts with a h4 element to indicate the title of the page.
